connector.name: Samotpravil MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Samotpravil API - docs, typed tools, Python SDK parity, safety flags.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package samotpravil-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dkanster account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SAMOTPRAVIL_READ_ONLY
env.description: When true, block mutating HTTP methods except GET/HEAD

env.name: SAMOTPRAVIL_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
env.description: When false, block stop-list, domain, authkey and other mutating endpoints

env.name: SAMOTPRAVIL_ALLOW_GENERIC_API
env.description: When false, disable the generic api_request tool

env.name: POSTMAN_API_KEY
env.description: Postman API key for maintainer tools (postman_get_collection, postman_sync_snapshot, …)

env.name: SAMOTPRAVIL_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token required for HTTP transport when exposed beyond localhost
